marketNotes.text: LDLC and LDLC.pro carry only one LTO item, an LTO-5 cartridge (HP C7975, 34.95 EUR); their search for lto-9 returns unrelated products.
TopTenStorage's French site shows gross prices with German 19% VAT, so its net prices are recorded (vatIncluded false).
Every TopTenStorage drive recorded is a refurbished unit sold with warranty.
Netram and Infolight show excluding-VAT (HT) prices only; recorded with vatIncluded false.
UGAP sells to French public-sector buyers only; the recorded price is its 1 to 9 unit tier, with a lower tier from 10 units.
No internal LTO-10 drive was offered by any French seller checked; the LTO-10 drives found are full-height Symply SAS units.
LTO-10 40 TB cartridges appeared only at PC21 (IBM 03PL413, Quantum MR-A10MQN-01), both on backorder.
PC21 shows a percentage discount against a crossed-out list price on many items; those are noted as sale.
Rue du Commerce is a marketplace; each datapoint is the default offer on the product page, and cheaper offers from other sellers may exist.
Amazon.fr returned one product page (HPE Q2079A, sold by Amazon); its search and later product pages returned a bot check.
123comparer prices come from shop feeds; the page says the PrintAbout price has been unchanged since 24 March 2026.
